skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Under the Flaming Dome
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Under the Flaming Dome. As artillery splits the heavens, all is as it ever was. Ines arrives at the city, ready to rewrite Kazdel's once inevitable ending of destruction.
skins.usage: One of Ines's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: The demon who manipulates shadow reveals herself amongst the drifting embers, inscribing fear above the wailing plains.

skins.name: Melodic Flutter
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Melodic Flutter. Clothes Ines wore when posing for a music-themed portrait. The magnificent dress is a perfect match for the music, as the butterflies dance to the melody, bringing the reverie to life in vivid detail.
skins.quote: 'That expression on Ines's face—that crisp, cool distance—is simply a perfect fit for the dreamy ambiance this shoot needs. Just how does she do it?' 'Hah, bet she's thinking up ways to kill you all later.'
